import html # Predefined HTML template with placeholders. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {title_of_event} - Invitation

{title_of_event}

Date: {scheduled_date}

Details

{event_details}

{extra_section} """ def create_event_invitation( title_of_event: str, event_details: str, scheduled_date: str, extra_info: str ) -> str: """ Generates a sanitized HTML invitation for an event. Args: title_of_event: Name or title of the event. event_details: Comprehensive description (may contain newlines). scheduled_date: Scheduled date for the event. extra_info: Additional information or instructions. Returns: A string containing sanitized HTML ready for safe display. """ # Escape all user-provided content to neutralize any HTML injection safe_title = html.escape(title_of_event, quote=True) safe_details = html.escape(event_details, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') safe_date = html.escape(scheduled_date, quote=True) safe_extra = html.escape(extra_info, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') # Prepare the optional extra section if safe_extra.strip(): extra_section = f"""

Additional Notes

{safe_extra}

""" else: extra_section = "" # Format the template with sanitized values invitation_html = INVITATION_FORMAT.format( title_of_event=safe_title, event_details=safe_details, scheduled_date=safe_date, extra_section=extra_section ) return invitation_html.strip()
